blocks.text: The hearing distinguishes priests, the temple captain, rulers, elders, scribes, and the high-priestly family rather than treating them as one undifferentiated authority. This matters because priestly leaders such as Caiaphas could exercise substantial local authority while still operating within Roman and client-royal power.

sections.title: A hearing with several kinds of authority

blocks.text: In the community’s prayer, words attributed to David frame the opposition to Jesus. New Testament writers regularly quote and echo psalms when speaking about Jesus’ suffering, resurrection, enthronement, mission, worship, creation rule, and the life of believing communities; here that scriptural language becomes part of the community’s response to threats.

The account of believers selling property and distributing proceeds according to need presents voluntary sharing as a community ideal in Acts’ summaries. It is not stated as a universal legal rule abolishing personal possession.
